mutations.rationale: Disabling the source editor's standard find bar removes the native find/replace route while leaving unrelated WYSIWYG configuration untouched.
mutations.find:
textView.usesFindBar = true
            textView.isIncrementalSearchingEnabled = true
            textView.textContainerInset = NSSize(width: 8, height: 8)
mutations.replace:
textView.usesFindBar = false
            textView.isIncrementalSearchingEnabled = true
            textView.textContainerInset = NSSize(width: 8, height: 8)
